notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard order-type controls. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies prospective default attribute order, per-object attribute-order override, receive-order interaction control, timestamped attribute and interaction delivery, order metadata, retraction metadata, and callback servicing. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, MOM behavior, DDM, save/restore, or interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador order-type controls, publication, subscription, registration, logical-time roles, timestamped update/send services, and FederateAmbassador discovery, time-role, reflection, interaction, and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador order-control and time-management declarations
